remote_diagnostic_transport_repair.mechanism: GitHub Actions invokes bash with errexit; a direct expected-nonzero validator command exited before rc capture. Guarding the command in an if/else preserved the validator exit code and allowed the diagnostic artifact to materialize.

remote_downstream_observation.interpretation: This establishes an independent downstream typed-IR failure on the frozen G9/Dialect path. It does not establish whether the preceding strict check passed, because the validator catches strict-check exceptions and continues into full_a before this uncaught typed-IR exception.

concurrent_strict_grammar_evidence.finding: V7 strict LALR construction has a dotted_relation optional-RHS conflict family.

blocker_2.name: TYPED_IR_VALUE_BASED_KEYWORD_IDENTIFIER_REJECTION
blocker_2.mechanism: V7 admits reserved-word aliases such as status in ident positions, while current typed IR discards token values listed in KEYWORDS when extracting field/parameter/declaration/method names.

two_blocker_fusion.scope_reconciliation: The earlier statement that the initial strict red was not caused by typed IR remains valid for that upstream causal question. It must not be generalized into 'typed IR has no bug': the later full_a path exposes a separate downstream defect.

typed_ir_candidate.strategy: Use AST context (direct NAME or ident_* child) rather than global token-value keyword filtering for declaration/field/parameter/method identifier extraction.
typed_ir_candidate.strongest_counterhypothesis: A selected V19-or-successor parser may intentionally alter normalized identifier AST shape or make this extraction strategy incomplete; therefore the candidate must be replayed against the selected exact grammar/frontend bytes before merge.

out_of_box_experiment.name: ERREXIT_RECEIPT_SURVIVAL_METAMORPHIC
out_of_box_experiment.direct_variant: set -euo pipefail; false; rc=$?; write receipt
out_of_box_experiment.guarded_variant: set -euo pipefail; if false; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi; write receipt
out_of_box_experiment.conclusion: Expected-failure diagnostics must place the command in an errexit-immune conditional context before capturing rc; otherwise the harness destroys the evidence it was built to collect.
out_of_box_experiment.rollback: Remove diagnostic wrapper change; no semantic state was mutated.
